census.note: PTF-CHARLOTTE-NC-ZERO-TO-LIVE-BENCHMARK-001 Charlotte census. Charlotte was built under the MODERN factory and has no legacy shadow market, so this census is written directly to identity_census/ -- the registered location -- rather than to a proposed directory it would later have to be promoted out of. No pinned census is overwritten: this order CREATES the file, and the release contract that pins its count is authored in the same registration batch. Every row carries the observations that produced it; nothing here carries a pet policy.

market.meta_description: Verified pet-friendly hotels across Greater Charlotte, North Carolina, with real pet fees and policies read from each hotel's own official website.
market.introductory_copy: Every listing links to a pet policy verified directly from the hotel's own official website.
market._boundary_note: PTF-CHARLOTTE-NC-ZERO-TO-LIVE-BENCHMARK-001 visitor market: the practical Greater Charlotte traveler lodging market, not the municipal line and not the Charlotte-Concord-Gastonia MSA. THE CORE IS A COUNTY POLYGON, the Lexington doctrine applied to a major metro: the whole of MECKLENBURG COUNTY, NORTH CAROLINA is admitted -- Uptown and Center City, South End and Dilworth, Elizabeth and Plaza Midwood and NoDa, SouthPark and Myers Park and the Park Road corridor, Charlotte Douglas Airport and West Charlotte, the Billy Graham Parkway / Yorkmont cluster, Arrowood and Steele Creek and Rivergate, Ballantyne and Piper Glen, University City and the Research Park, Northlake, East Charlotte and Mint Hill, Matthews, Pineville, and the Lake Norman towns of Huntersville, Cornelius and Davidson. PLUS three contiguous corridors admitted on FIRST-PARTY EVIDENCE, each of which the operators' own published property names call CHARLOTTE: Concord on I-85 northeast, where Marriott files courtyard-charlotte-concord, residence-inn-charlotte-concord and springhill-suites-charlotte-concord-mills-speedway; Belmont and Gastonia on I-85 southwest, where the same roster files fairfield-inn-and-suites-charlotte-belmont, courtyard-charlotte-gastonia and fairfield-inn-charlotte-gastonia; and Fort Mill / Carowinds / Indian Land on I-77 south across the SOUTH CAROLINA state line, where it files courtyard-charlotte-fort-mill-sc, towneplace-suites-charlotte-fort-mill and springhill-suites-charlotte-at-carowinds -- Carowinds itself straddles the state line at Charlotte's own southern edge. HELD FOR A FOUNDER RULING, authored as corridors that claim no postal code and therefore admit nothing: Rock Hill South Carolina, Kannapolis, Mooresville and the north Lake Norman shore, and Monroe / Indian Trail / Waxhaw in Union County. EXCLUDED OUTRIGHT: Salisbury, Statesville, Hickory, Shelby, Lincolnton and Denver, Albemarle, and Chester and Lancaster South Carolina -- several of which are reached by a CLT-prefixed Marriott property code (cltby is Shelby, cltfv is Statesville, cltht is Hickory, cltsb is Salisbury), which is precisely why a code prefix is a SELECTOR here and never a membership decision. Nashville taught that rule with BNA; Charlotte inherits it with CLT. No committed discovery box overlaps this one: the nearest committed market, Nashville, Tennessee, ends at -86.35 W, more than five degrees of longitude west.
market._corridor_note: Corridors are a postal-code partition (census_membership_basis CORRIDOR_REGISTRY). Every admitted lodging ZIP is claimed by exactly one corridor, so a discovered hotel is never placed by mailing city -- 'Charlotte' is the mailing city of Ballantyne, Steele Creek, University City, SouthPark, Northlake and Mint Hill alike and decides nothing, and Marriott's own roster proves the reverse too, filing a Fort Mill SOUTH CAROLINA property under a charlotte slug. ZIP 28217 is split out of the airport corridor because Billy Graham Parkway and Yorkmont Road are the airport's south approach and a distinct traveler cluster from the terminal and Wilkinson Boulevard. ZIP 28226 joins SouthPark rather than Ballantyne because Carmel and Beverly Woods face Providence Road, not I-485. ZIP 28270 joins Ballantyne rather than Matthews because Raintree and Providence Plantation sit inside the I-485 loop on the Ballantyne side. ZIP 28075 (Harrisburg) joins the Concord corridor rather than University City because NC-49 carries it to Concord, not to the Research Park.
market._founder_hold_note: A corridor whose included_postal_codes is EMPTY and whose _held_postal_codes is not is a FOUNDER HOLD authored by PTF-CHARLOTTE-NC-ZERO-TO-LIVE-BENCHMARK-001. It claims nothing and admits nothing: every hotel in those ZIPs is discovered, identified and then classified OUT_OF_MARKET_BOUNDARY_DECISION, so the founder rules on evidence rather than on an absence. Admitting one is a one-line move of the ZIPs from _held_postal_codes into included_postal_codes and is fully reversible. No held row is published, counted as census, or given paid acquisition budget by this order.
market._census_membership_note: Membership is decided by the property's OWN postal code as its own official page states it, joined to the corridor registry above. A brand property code, a brand URL path segment, a mailing city and a competitor directory's city page are all SELECTORS that bring a candidate into view; none of them admits it.
